title: Defense-Grade Autonomous Intelligence Systems & Zero-Trust Governance Benchmark

platforms_analyzed.core_pillar: Semantic Data Ontology, Immutable Provenance Lineage & Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
architectural_principles: Strict data lineage tracking from raw ingestion to derived insights
Fine-grained ABAC security markings at the object and property level
Deterministic data transformations with branching and merge governance

platforms_analyzed.core_pillar: Autonomous Command & Control (C2), Real-Time Threat Assessment & Fail-Safe Edge Architecture
architectural_principles: Distributed multi-entity sensor fusion and telemetry convergence
Autonomous threat scoring and millisecond policy enforcement
Fail-safe hardware-isolated circuit breakers and kill-switch protocols

platforms_analyzed.platform: NSA AISC & AWS GovCloud / Palo Alto Networks
platforms_analyzed.core_pillar: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), Ephemeral Privilege Envelopes & Secret-Less Authentication
architectural_principles: Never trust, always verify (Continuous cryptographic posture evaluation)
Ephemeral, purpose-bound authorization tokens with strict TTL
Zero raw secrets in flight or memory; cryptographic envelope encryption

platforms_analyzed.platform: Devin AI, Factory.ai, Replit Agent, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n
platforms_analyzed.core_pillar: Cyclic Graph State Machines, Agent Hierarchies & Deterministic Checkpoint Rollbacks
architectural_principles: StateGraph loops with deterministic edge transitions and condition checkpoints
Hermetic sandboxes with automated regression self-healing

core_triad.WHY: Garantizar la soberanía, confiabilidad matemática, seguridad infranqueable y no-repudio absoluto en sistemas de ingeniería autónomos.
core_triad.WHAT_FOR: Permitir que la inteligencia artificial ejecute ingeniería compleja con la precisión y resiliencia de misiones de defensa y aeroespaciales.
core_triad.HOW: Mediante una arquitectura de 5 capas: Zero-Trust ABAC, Ontología Semántica Inmutable, Redundancia BFT/TMR, FDIR Hermético y Checkpointing StateGraph con trazabilidad SHA-256.
